claims.text: Gazette No. 19 of Monday 11 September 2006 carries a proclamation in the name of His Majesty George Tupou V, by Prime Minister Feleti Vaka'uta Sevele, stating that by the decease of His Late Majesty King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV the Crown of the Kingdom of Tonga devolves upon Crown Prince Tupouto'a. The ministers, as members of the Privy Council, Speaker Tu'iha'angana and Chief Justice Anthony David Ford proclaim that Crown Prince Tupouto'a 'has now become the only lawful and rightful heir to the throne, King of the Kingdom of Tonga', as King George Tupou V. It is given at Nuku'alofa on 11 September 2006 and signed by Ma'afu, Clerk to the Privy Council.
claims.locator: Reproduced gazette header, proclamation text and sign-off; article timestamp Sep 11, 2006, 18:44
claims.uncertainty: The proclamation is its own event, dated 11 September 2006; it does not state the date or time of the death. Its statement that the Crown devolved by the decease is the basis for the accession date (TO-CROWN-04); the proclamation date is not used as the start. PMO web reproduction, not the gazette facsimile.
